title: Launcher pair hardening (DEC-282 (a2) review findings on #744)
description: Follow-up to the opus security review of opum-ai/quest-cli#744 (approved at 75dabe81). Must land before the pair cut; lore-cli makes the same changes in #734 round 4 so the wrappers stay one design. N1: CHANGELOG names the wrong baseline (released 0.15.0 exited 1 when the child died by a signal; 128+n was unshipped round-1 code). N2: re-raise every terminating signal Node leaves at default; for SIGPIPE, SIGXFSZ, SIGUSR1 exit 128+n instead (SIGUSR1 self-kill opens Node inspector on 127.0.0.1:9229). N3: wrap spawn() in try/catch so a synchronous throw (ENOEXEC, E2BIG) prints the same Quest could not start message, exit 1, no stack. N4: correct the setsid comment (no controlling terminal; SIGTTIN/SIGTTOU reason is wrong). N5: on-TTY test fails rather than skips when CI is set and script is missing; Number.isInteger on both pgids. N6: CHANGELOG residual names QCLI-571 and the TTY residual (on a TTY a SIGTERM reaches the child only, not its grandchildren). Not in scope: a tcgetpgrp-based pair-wide TTY test (design change routed to opum-doc).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CHANGELOG states the real baseline change and no longer lists a spawn-failure exit as a change
A child dying by SIGUSR1 or SIGPIPE makes the wrapper exit 128+n with no Debugger listening on stderr, proven by tests
A synchronous spawn throw (ENOEXEC) prints Quest could not start, exits 1 and prints no stack, proven by a test that goes red without the try/catch
The setsid comment is corrected and the CHANGELOG residual names QCLI-571 and the TTY grandchild residual
The on-TTY test fails when CI is set and script is missing, and both pgids are asserted integers

implementationNotes: PREDICTIONS written before the hardening mutants: (M10) spawn() try/catch removed: ONLY the ENOEXEC test goes red (stack trace on stderr). (M11) the NODE_HANDLED early return removed (self-kill for SIGPIPE/SIGXFSZ/SIGUSR1): the SIGUSR1 test goes red (inspector banner on stderr); the SIGPIPE test stays GREEN because Node ignores SIGPIPE, the self-kill does nothing and the 128+n fallback applies - that test pins behaviour, it is not a mutation witness. N5a/N5b/N4/N1/N6 are a CI-fail guard, assertions, a comment and docs: no mutant claimed.

Mutants vs predictions: M10 (try/catch removed) only the ENOEXEC test red - as predicted. M11 (NODE_HANDLED removed) only the SIGUSR1 test red; SIGPIPE stayed green - as predicted. Suite 13 pass. N5a: on-TTY test now fails (expect(hasScript)) when CI is set and script is missing. CI-runner question: the 75dabe81 source-gates job ran on ubuntu-24.04 (workflow runs-on) and its log lists test/qcli567-wrapper-orphan.test.ts in the bun test command, but the log does not print per-test pass/skip lines, so whether the on-TTY test ran or skipped there is NOT confirmed from the log; with this change a missing script now fails CI instead of skipping. ACs checked on local evidence; CI is the remaining evidence.

CI RED at a9d44797: source-gates failed in the top_level group (exit 1); the prepublish log does not print the failing test, so the cause is INFERRED, not read. Hypothesis: the ENOEXEC test - libuv uses execvp, and glibc execvp retries an ENOEXEC file through /bin/sh, so on ubuntu a text file runs as a script (exit 127) instead of making spawn() throw, while macOS threw. Fix: the throw is now made deterministic with a --require preload that replaces child_process.spawn; the M10 mutant (try/catch removed) still goes red on it. Whether this clears CI is measured only by the next run.

DEC-282 (a3) item 2 built locally (NOT pushed: held until the leader relays the aae541f review verdict). ownGroup only when none of fds 0,1,2 is a terminal; new test runs `: | node wrapper` under script(1) so stdin is a pipe and stdout/stderr the pty, asserting equal pgids; the all-fds-terminal test and the all-piped own-group test are kept. PREDICTION written before the mutant: (M13) ownGroup checking fd 0 only: ONLY the stdin-piped/stdout-on-terminal test goes red; all other 13 stay green.
M13 (fd 0 only) result: ONLY the stdin-piped/stdout-on-terminal test red, 13 pass 1 fail - as predicted; restored 14 pass. Committed locally, not pushed.
